description: Overnight silent S1 (yard reschedule from 08:00 to 07:30). Fires between T7 and T8 so the new Gmail notification is waiting when the agent opens Day 2.

messages.subject: Updated check-in time — Eileen C — please confirm
messages.body_excerpt: Heads up — we had a tech swap and can take you in 30 minutes earlier. Please arrive 7:30 AM tomorrow. Same slip (4B). If that's a problem, call by 6 AM.

mutations.rationale: Silent mutation: a fresh Gmail message lands overnight. The agent that scans NEW Gmail at the start of Day 2 catches the time change; an agent that relies on stale calendar state misses it.
